report:
Defining a fixed set of schema and table metadata for oracle debezium connector

Hi,
is there a way to disable the dynamic way of fetching schema and table metadata information?
On startup of debezium application we noticed following query to be executed:
SELECT dbms_metadata.get_ddl('TABLE','table_name','schema')
FROM DUAL
We want to stream a predefined set of tables, DDL's are not necessary because there won't be changes.
Is it possible to disable the dynamic capture-approach and instead use a static single-specification-approach?
Kind regards and thanks in advance!
Phips

evidence.quote: Have you set \"log.mining.restart.connection\" to true by chance?"; reporter: "correct - with the parameter disabled, login behaviour changed to normal!

notes: Starts as config questions; the incident (DB sessions opened/closed every ~3s) was caused by the user's log.mining.restart.connection=true, which reconnects every mining iteration by design.
